_comment: Demo data, loaded when the 'demo' profile is active and the catalog is empty. ISBNs are placeholders with valid check digits; they don't identify the real editions. Descriptions are short summaries written for this demo. Genres refer to the genres seeded by migration V7.

books.title: Dune
books.description: On the desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the precious spice, young Paul Atreides is drawn into a struggle between noble houses, an empire and the planet's desert people.

books.title: Dune Messiah
books.description: Twelve years after his rise to power, Paul Atreides rules an empire waging holy war in his name and sees no way to stop what he started.

books.title: Children of Dune
books.description: Paul's twin children inherit the desert world of Arrakis and an empire built on spice, prophecy and religion.

books.title: Foundation
books.description: A mathematician who can predict the future of whole societies foresees the fall of the Galactic Empire and sets out to shorten the dark age that follows.

books.title: I, Robot
books.description: Linked stories about robots bound by three laws meant to keep humans safe, and the surprising ways those laws play out.

books.title: Neuromancer
books.description: A burned-out computer hacker is hired for one last job in cyberspace, working for an employer with an artificial intelligence behind it.

books.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
books.description: A gifted, proud boy studying magic on an island archipelago unleashes a shadow on the world and must hunt it down.

books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.description: An envoy to a frozen planet whose people have no fixed sex struggles to understand them as political intrigue closes in.

books.title: Good Omens
books.description: An angel and a demon who have grown fond of life on Earth team up to stop the apocalypse, complicated by a misplaced Antichrist.

books.title: Guards! Guards!
books.description: The hapless City Watch of Ankh-Morpork has to deal with a secret society that summons a dragon to take over the city.

books.title: American Gods
books.description: A newly released convict becomes the bodyguard of a mysterious old man, and is drawn into a war between old gods brought to America and new ones.

books.title: The Hobbit
books.description: A comfort-loving hobbit is swept into a quest with thirteen dwarves and a wizard to reclaim treasure guarded by a dragon.

books.title: Murder on the Orient Express
books.description: Detective Hercule Poirot investigates a murder on a train stranded in the snow, where every passenger seems to have something to hide.

books.title: And Then There Were None
books.description: Ten strangers invited to a remote island are accused of past crimes and start dying one by one.

books.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
books.description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate a family legend of a spectral hound haunting the moors.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.description: A young scientist creates a living being and abandons it, setting off a tragedy of loneliness and revenge.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy misjudge each other in a story of manners, money and marriage in Regency England.

books.title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
books.description: In a state of total surveillance, a low-level official begins to doubt the regime that rewrites history and controls thought.

books.title: Animal Farm
books.description: Farm animals overthrow their human owner, only for the pigs who lead them to become the new masters.

books.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
books.description: Moments before Earth is demolished for a hyperspace bypass, an ordinary man is rescued by a friend who turns out to be an alien travel writer.

books.title: The Martian
books.description: An astronaut left behind on Mars after a dust storm has to survive with engineering, botany and stubbornness until rescue can reach him.

books.title: Sapiens
books.description: A brief history of humankind, from foragers to farmers to the scientific revolution, and how shared stories let people cooperate in large numbers.

books.title: Cosmos
books.description: A tour of the universe and of the history of science, from ancient astronomers to the search for life beyond Earth.

books.title: The Shining
books.description: A struggling writer takes a winter caretaker job at an isolated hotel with his family, and the hotel begins to work on him.

books.title: The Three-Body Problem
books.description: A secret military project during China's Cultural Revolution sends a signal into space, and decades later the answer begins to change the world.

books.title: The Silmarillion
books.description: The myths and legends of the elder days of Middle-earth, from its creation to the war against the first Dark Lord.
